Handmade jewellery, made to be celebrated.
Kavya Mehra
Kaya Jewels was started in 2021 by Kavya Mehra at her home in Jaipur, Rajasthan, with two karigars (artisans).
Today every piece is handmade in our Jaipur studio by a team of 6 women artisans. Each design takes 2 to 4 days to make.
We sell on Instagram (order by DM) and through our online store. During this campaign every call to action points to the waitlist form.
Our pieces use brass with gold plating, kundan-style glass stones, glass beads, freshwater pearls and hand-painted meenakari enamel. One design uses 925 sterling silver.
The Roshni Edit
The Roshni Edit is our Diwali 2026 collection: 6 handmade designs inspired by diyas, rangoli and the jharokha windows of Jaipur's old city.
Roshni Kundan Jhumkas: gold-plated brass jhumkas with kundan-style stones and freshwater pearl drops. ₹2,450.
Diya Meenakari Studs: lightweight studs with hand-painted red and green meenakari. ₹1,200.
Rangoli Maang Tikka: gold-plated brass maang tikka with pink glass beads. ₹1,850.
Jharokha Layered Necklace: two-layer gold-plated brass necklace with jharokha-shaped pendants. ₹3,900.
Chandni Silver Bangles (set of 2): 925 sterling silver bangles with hand-engraved motifs. ₹4,800.
Tara Choker Set: kundan-style choker with matching earrings. ₹6,500.
Prices in The Roshni Edit range from ₹1,200 to ₹6,500.
Free shipping across India on orders above ₹1,999. Orders are dispatched within 3 working days.
Every order arrives in a reusable cotton pouch inside a gift box, ready for Diwali gifting.
Care tips: keep pieces away from water and perfume, wipe them with a soft dry cloth and store them in their pouch.
